title: Remote foundations M4: satellite wake and command journals, receipt-only acknowledgement and recovery (central host or satellite down, restarts, unknown outcomes)
outcome: Remote foundations M4: satellite wake and command journals, receipt-only acknowledgement and recovery (central host or satellite down, restarts, unknown outcomes)
acceptance: The satellite persists a deduplicated wake/command obligation before reporting acceptance; received, queued, runtime-accepted and processed stay distinct; boot on either host recovers the intent and wake journals without duplicate queue entries (tests at every persistence cut).

Central host down: already-admitted runtime work continues under local constraints; no new central lifecycle admission, timeout reassignment or alternate-executor retry; local emergency stop stays available; the central view shows unknown/last observed, never 'stopped' by timeout (tests).

Stale epochs, re-enrollment, delayed stop/start outcomes, a central stop with an unknown executor outcome, stale page/receipt replay and receipts from another host or epoch are refused or held for reconciliation, never rerouted to a second host (tests).
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
